description: Gauge models: dial angles and ticks, needle polygon, damping (incl. wrap), seven-segment masks and text, LED arrays, knob/slider pointer math, attitude horizon; drawing parity per gauge.

cases.name: radial: angles, ticks, needle polygon, formatting
radial: half sweep layout and arc needle
damping: exponential approach, settles, wraps across 0/360
linear: positions along horizontal and vertical tracks
led array: level and bit modes
knob: pointer angle → value with dead zone, snapping and nudging
attitude: horizon polygon for pitch and roll
